blocks.text: Question: Hurray! What's your favourite place beyond the solar system, then?
Question: Pretty Star-chy if you ask us! Speaking of carbs, if one could remove the limiter from your BreadDog plushie, how big would it get?
Answer: It would get big enough that I could headplant into it. Also I recommend doing it away from the Earth otherwise it would soak up the planet like a sponge.
Question: And would you rather fight 100 BreadDogs or 1 BEEG Sana-sized BreadDog?
Answer: Why do we have to fight? Let’s play instead!
Question: Aww! Also, how's San doing? What's he up to these days?
Answer: I hear he’s a senpai for some male talents now… But lately he’s just flying his big rocket out in space somewhere. I think he’s doing fine.
Question: Got it! On to a different topic, what made you decide to audition for hololive?
Answer: I think the talents at hololive are really cute! When I first got interested in Vtubers I was mainly watching Fubuki.
I thought that she was adorable, but I also noticed that her viewer community was so positive and welcoming to everything and anything she wanted to do.
I felt like I too wanted to find that kind of community for myself, to meet people who would accept me for who I am and to have fun with them.
Question: Well, it seems you were certainly able to find that in the Sanallites! What were your first thoughts after your audition and after you got accepted to hololive?
Answer: I thought to myself, “I’ve gotten this far but I gotta work really hard from here on out, and I’m so excited to meet other amazing talents from different walks of life.
”Also, as the Speaker of Space, I was excited to finally be able to come to Earth!
